roots.title: Optimization under Uncertainty
roots.top_down_role: Adaptive-depth structural navigation for Optimization under Uncertainty; formal statements are stored in a later sidecar layer.

children.title: Recourse Model Structure
children.top_down_role: Structural foundations of stochastic programs whose decisions adapt to revealed uncertainty; detailed algorithms, sampling theory, risk-measure theory, and application models remain in linked chapters.

children.title: Scenario Decomposition Architecture
children.top_down_role: Scenario representations, finite-distribution approximations, statistical solution assessment, and decomposition methods for two-stage and multistage stochastic programs.

children.title: Stochastic Mixed-Integer Programming
children.top_down_role: Finite- and multistage stochastic optimization models whose decision structure includes discrete variables, emphasizing recourse geometry, exact and approximate formulations, decomposition, certificates, computational regimes, and representative application architectures.

children.title: Risk-Reliability Optimization
children.top_down_role: Static and single-period risk functionals, risk-averse optimization models, probabilistic constraints, tractable reformulations, sampling guarantees, and the principal bridges between risk measures and reliability constraints.

children.title: Distributionally Robust Optimization
children.top_down_role: Distributional ambiguity in optimization, including ambiguity-set design, model families, tractable representations, computational methods, statistical guarantees, dynamic extensions, applications, and failure regimes.

children.title: Dynamic Risk Models
children.top_down_role: Discrete-time dynamic risk systems and their role in risk-averse multistage stochastic optimization; static risk theory, general stochastic programming, continuous-time control, and distributionally robust optimization enter only through interfaces.

children.title: Robust Optimization
children.top_down_role: Deterministic and distributional robustness for optimization under uncertain data, including tractable counterparts, adaptive policies, computational methods, guarantees, and failure boundaries.

children.title: Simulation Optimization
children.top_down_role: Optimization driven by stochastic simulator evaluations, including statistical estimation, finite-alternative selection, noisy search, discrete-event systems, and simulation-specific guarantees.

children.title: Bayesian Optimization Surrogate-Acquisition Architecture
children.top_down_role: Probabilistic surrogate construction, acquisition-policy design, theoretical performance families, computational realization, structured variants, and failure boundaries for expensive black-box optimization.

children.title: Structure-Resource Bayesian Optimization
children.top_down_role: Bayesian optimization organized around exploitable problem structure, heterogeneous evaluation resources, and their interactions; foundational surrogate modeling and generic acquisition policies remain dependencies.

children.title: Bayesian Optimization Guarantee Calculus under Noise
children.top_down_role: Theory and methodology for performance guarantees, observation noise, posterior and policy consistency, computational validity, and failure boundaries in Bayesian optimization.
